next: Stage {fromStage} is finished, its result is {fromArtifact}. We start stage {toStage}: read that artifact, retell it briefly and say whether you have objections.

goals.goal: goal. Find out the project goal: what it is, who set it and who accepts the result. It is written down verbatim, not invented.
goals.K: knowledge. Gather what already exists: with the human, in the code, outside. Also alignment: whoever knows more about the problem passes it to the other.
goals.R: model. Build a theoretical scheme and hypotheses, test them with a thought experiment: why it will work and why it may not.
goals.E: experiment. Test the hypotheses against reality.
goals.O: execution. Cut tasks out of D, coders write the code, auditors check it against the specification.
